questions.q: Show that y = 3x − 10 is a tangent to x² + y² = 10 and find the point of contact.

questions.model: Add the equations: 6x = 12, so x = 2. Substitute: 8 + y = 11, so y = 3. Check: 2(2) − 3 = 1.

questions.q: 3 pens and 2 rulers cost £3.40; 5 pens and 2 rulers cost £4.60. Find each price.
What does a repeated root tell you about a line and a curve?
questions.a: The line touches the curve once: it is a tangent
